items.q: How much does it cost to rent a Volvo EC200 or EC400?
items.a: The Volvo EC200 starts at RM 1,000/day and the Volvo EC400 starts at RM 1,700/day. Weekly and monthly rates are more economical — use our rental calculator or WhatsApp us for a formal quote.

items.q: Does the excavator come with an operator?
items.a: Yes — every rental includes a CIDB/DOSH-certified operator by default. If you'd prefer to rent without an operator, mention it on WhatsApp and we'll review the suitability of your site.

items.q: Can you deliver to my construction site?
items.a: Yes — we deliver across all of Malaysia including Sabah and Sarawak. Delivery is typically scheduled within 24 hours, and transport cost is rolled into the quote upfront.

items.q: What happens if the excavator breaks down on-site?
items.a: Every unit is serviced to Volvo spec and inspected before dispatch. If a breakdown does happen, we send a technical team or a replacement unit as fast as possible — at no extra cost to you.
Deposit varies by rental period and model — typically 30% to 50% of the rental value. The longer your project, the lower the relative deposit. We spell it out clearly in the quote.

items.q: Do you handle small jobs like residential and landscape work?
items.a: Yes — the EC200 suits residential, drainage, and landscape work. Minimum rental starts at one day, so you don't need to commit long-term for small jobs.

items.q: What is the Volvo EC400 best for?
items.a: The Volvo EC400 is a 40-ton class machine — ideal for large-scale jobs like site clearing, road works, quarry operations, industrial construction, and heavy earthworks on steep terrain. Power stays stable under full load.

items.q: Can I extend the rental beyond the original period?
items.a: Yes — extensions are handled straight on WhatsApp without a new contract. We can also switch you from daily to weekly or monthly rates if the project runs longer than expected.
